baseline.terrain_taxonomy: 26 zoneType groups used by the existing website and installed worldgen assets

interpretation_rules: Native means the extracted zone union contains the required starting element, plant, critter, or feature in at least one variant; it does not guarantee that every map seed contains it.
Imported means the method requires material, seed, critter, infrastructure, or atmosphere not shown in that zone union.
Finite means worldgen stock can be exhausted unless another renewable loop, geyser, meteor, care package, ranch, or rocket source is established.
Radiation production applies only when Spaced Out radiation mechanics are enabled. In base-game-only play, radiation and radbolts are not applicable.
Recommendations intentionally avoid exact per-cycle ratios unless the current U59 value was verified; beta-era community numbers are not promoted as stable facts.

zones.summary: Deep Aquatic biome with Galena, Basalt, Diamond, polluted brine, Glo Squid, Tublia, Pinpoket, Bulbloom, and Abyss vents/fissures depending on the generated world.

food.method: Ranch or harvest Glo Squid for the Calamari food chain
Import a proven crop or compact food reserve before permanent settlement

energy.method: Use finite Carbon/Coal only as a bridge

Where a Thermal Gas Fissure exists, measure its output cycle before a Steam Turbine system; turbine input Steam must reach at least 125°C, the turbine body must stay below 100°C, and dormant periods need heat buffering

oxygen.method: Pipe or carry oxygen from an established system and use Breathing Stations for underwater work
No dependable native one-building clean-oxygen route; polluted-brine treatment chains exceed the direct-path policy and are only advanced context

radiation.method: Import passive Wheezewort or Shine Bugs as ambient radiation sources, then use one Radbolt Generator to collect the field; a powered Radiation Lamp plus a Radbolt Generator is a two-active-building advanced chain and is not ranked as direct

attention: Deep flooding and long breath paths
No dependable native food or oxygen loop in every variant

zones.summary: Sparse terrain whose installed variants can include regolith, metals, Coal, ice, and Shove Voles; exact composition differs strongly by asteroid and DLC variant.

food.method: Contain and ranch Shove Voles for meat where they spawn
Import durable food or a crop because flora is absent

energy.method: Use finite Coal deposits as bootstrap power
Use Solar Panels if the barren region is at or connected to exposed surface

oxygen.method: Melt native-variant ice where present and electrolyze the water, or pipe/import oxygen

radiation.method: Use nearby space exposure when accessible; otherwise import Wheezewort/Shine Bugs

attention: Shove Voles burrow through many materials and can escape
One installed HardDust biome reference has no matching lookup key and is flagged unresolved

zones.summary: Aquatic starting terrain with Zinc Ore, algae, Oxylite, Sand, Salt, Sulfur, Gum Palm, Mussel Sprout, Sodicane, Husha Cups, Slogo, and Pokeshell variants.

food.method: Use finite Mussel Sprouts while establishing Sodicane farming and aquatic/critter food
Treat wild forage as a bridge, not a permanent calorie budget

energy.method: Start with Manual Generators; no Beach-native direct fuel route is guaranteed
Do not plan on a native Tidal Turbine in Beach; official 735589 moved Tidal Springs to Reef

oxygen.method: Use starting Oxylite and Algae Diffusers, then move to water electrolysis or a Reef Flue Coral/Blowter system

radiation.method: Import Wheezewort or Shine Bugs; protect aquatic farms from unwanted heating/crowding rather than assuming a native source

attention: Tidal Spring advice for Beach is obsolete after 735589
Flooding, Soggy Feet, breath and swim-skill limits
Gum Palm and aquatic farming infrastructure costs

zones.summary: Classic Marsh terrain with Slime, Polluted Water/Oxygen, algae, Gold Amalgam, Dusk Caps, Thimble Reeds, Pacu, Pufts, and Slimelung risk.

food.method: Grow Dusk Caps from Slime and ranch Pacu for food plus eggshell material

energy.method: Use Manual Generators unless a directly usable local fuel or geyser is proven by the exact world; polluted-water-to-hydrogen chains exceed the direct-path policy

oxygen.method: Breathe native Polluted Oxygen as an emergency source or clean it with one Deodorizer; use one Oxygen Diffuser where local Algae exists

radiation.method: Import Shine Bugs or Wheezeworts; the marsh itself has no dependable native source

attention: Slimelung in Slime and polluted oxygen
Keep Thimble Reed water use within budget

zones.summary: Frosty Carrot Quarry terrain with Plume Squash, Bammoths, ice, iron ore, and some ethanol-bearing variants.

food.method: Farm Plume Squash and ranch Bammoths for renewable food and fiber outputs

energy.method: Use finite Ethanol pockets carefully; establish imported renewable fuel or a connected Ceres wood/ethanol loop

oxygen.method: Import Alveo Vera seeds from Ice Caves or melt ice for an electrolyzer

radiation.method: Import Wheezewort or Shine Bugs

attention: Melting ice changes terrain and can flood work areas
Do not count finite ethanol as sustainable

zones.summary: Dry starting terrain with Aluminum Ore, Arbor Trees, Pips, Oxyferns, Mealwood, Shine Bugs, and little or no algae/Coal in typical Forest starts.

food.method: Use Hexalent forage briefly, then Mealwood; use Pips and Arbor Trees to improve long-term Dirt/wood sustainability

energy.method: Burn native Arbor Tree Lumber directly in a Wood Burner; the Lumber-to-Ethanol-to-generator chain is advanced context and excluded from direct ranking

oxygen.method: Use Oxyferns only as a supplement; explore early for water and transition to an electrolyzer or imported algae

radiation.method: Ranch native Shine Bugs and collect their ambient radiation with a Radbolt Generator

attention: Oxyferns usually do not sustain a growing colony alone
Ethanol chains produce heat and byproducts
Pip planting requires controlled natural tiles

zones.summary: Tundra/Frozen terrain containing ice, polluted ice, Sleet Wheat, Wheezewort, Wolframite, and sometimes Shove Voles.

food.method: Preserve wild Sleet Wheat initially, then farm it with temperature-controlled water plus Dirt from a connected or imported source
Ranch Shove Voles where present

energy.method: Use imported fuel or exploit connected geothermal/vent power

oxygen.method: Use existing native Oxygen pockets only as a bridge, then melt ice for water electrolysis with careful heat management

radiation.method: Use native Wheezeworts; wild planting avoids Phosphorite consumption while retaining radiation

zones.summary: Ceres starting terrain with ice/snow, Pikeapple, Flox, Alveo Vera, Sherberry, and Idylla.

food.method: Transition finite Sherberries to Pikeapple farming; ranch Floxes only after feed supply is stable

energy.method: Burn Flox Lumber directly in a Wood Burner or bootstrap with Manual Generators; the ethanol chain exceeds the direct-path policy

oxygen.method: Farm Alveo Vera using Carbon Dioxide and Ice to produce Oxylite; later melt ice and electrolyze water

radiation.method: Import a Wheezewort/Shine Bug source; Ice Cave flora itself does not provide dependable ambient radiation

attention: Warm Coats and insulated living areas
Alveo Vera needs a managed CO2 supply
Oxylite behavior can alter the local gas balance
Heating liquefiable Snow/Ice can collapse large areas

zones.summary: Aquatic Kelp Forest with Polluted Water/Oxygen, Polluted Mud, Tower Kelp, Kelpoles, Orehulls, Thimble Reed, and Buddy Bud.

food.method: Harvest Kelpoles for ingredient-only Nori and use exact Orehull edible drops where defined; Nori has 0 raw kcal and is not a standalone food foundation

energy.method: Use Manual Generators first; no Kelp-Forest-native direct generator fuel is guaranteed, and polluted-water cleanup plus electrolysis plus generation exceeds the direct-path policy

oxygen.method: Use native Polluted Oxygen directly or clean it with one Deodorizer; polluted-water treatment chains are advanced context, not a direct recommendation

radiation.method: Import Wheezewort or Shine Bugs

attention: Orehull grooming/pathing fixes require current U59
Thimble Reed can consume large water quantities

zones.summary: Lifeless extreme-heat terrain with Magma, Obsidian, Igneous Rock, and Neutronium; Abyssalite may surround regions but is not present in the extracted zone-element union.

food.method: Do not farm here; import food and isolate any nearby ranch or farm thermally

energy.method: Extract geothermal heat into a controlled Steam Turbine chamber; input Steam must reach at least 125°C, the turbine body must stay below 100°C, and the system needs controlled heat transfer and cooling

oxygen.method: Use sealed Atmo Suit access and pipe oxygen from elsewhere

radiation.method: Import a radiation source; Magma is not a radiation generator

attention: Steam Turbines are not a free-power device without a heat source and controlled cooling

zones.summary: Sparse metallic terrain with high-value ore variants and no dependable native flora or fauna.

food.method: Import compact long-life food or build a sealed imported farm

energy.method: Use imported fuel, connected solar power, or local geothermal only when the asteroid layout supports it

oxygen.method: Consume finite Oxylite only as a landing reserve, then pipe oxygen or import water

radiation.method: Use exposed space where available or import Wheezeworts/Shine Bugs

attention: Do not confuse valuable ore with renewable supply

zones.summary: Extremely cold chlorine/methane terrain with Gas Grass and Gassy Moos.

food.method: Do not rely on Gassy Moos as a self-replacing staple; import normal food production

energy.method: Ranch Gassy Moos on Gas Grass for Natural Gas, with a backup because reproduction/supply is constrained

oxygen.method: Use Atmo Suits and imported oxygen; the biome has no native breathable-gas loop

radiation.method: Use nearby space radiation if exposed; otherwise import a source

attention: Gassy Moo population and feed sustainability

zones.summary: Tide Pool/Ocean terrain with Salt Water or Brine, Salt, Fossil, Sedimentary Rock, Waterweed, Pokeshells, Pacu, and some Pincha Pepperplant variants.

food.method: Farm Waterweed for lettuce and ranch Pacu; use Pokeshell products primarily as industrial support

energy.method: Use a Manual Generator; desalination to electrolysis to hydrogen generation is a multi-building advanced chain and is not ranked as direct power

oxygen.method: No dependable native one-building clean-oxygen route; desalination plus electrolysis is a two-active-building advanced chain and is not ranked as direct

radiation.method: Import Wheezewort or Shine Bugs

attention: Preserve sedimentary rock if Stone Hatch morphs are desired

zones.summary: Hot Oily terrain with Crude Oil, Lead, Fossil, Diamond features, Slicksters, and dangerous Sporechids.

food.method: Ranch Slicksters for meat while converting colony CO2 to oil
Import a heat-tolerant or insulated crop system

energy.method: Use a Manual Generator unless the exact world has a directly usable Natural Gas source; refining or boiling Crude Oil before a Petroleum Generator is an advanced chain and is not ranked as direct

oxygen.method: Pipe oxygen through an Atmo Suit network; use imported or geyser water for electrolysis

radiation.method: Import a controlled radiation source

attention: Oil reservoirs and wells require water and pressure management

zones.summary: Temperate Garden terrain with Peat, Nickel Ore, Shale, Snactus, Sweatcorn, Ovagro, Lumbs, and Mimikas.

food.method: Use Snactus forage first, then Sweatcorn and fully developed Ovagro; use Lumb/Mimika effects to improve farms

energy.method: Burn native Peat in a Peat Burner while developing a renewable secondary source

oxygen.method: Use finite Oxylite/algae as bootstrap, then electrolyze local or connected water

radiation.method: Import Wheezeworts or Shine Bugs

attention: Avoid consuming all starting Oxylite before replacement oxygen is online

zones.summary: Cold Feather terrain with Chlorine, Brine Ice, Rhex, Dartle, Megafrond, Dew Dripper, and Wheezewort.

food.method: Build a Dartle-supported Rhex ranch; process tough Rhex meat before serving

energy.method: Import Peat, ethanol, or electrical supply; treat ranch outputs as food/fiber/resource loops rather than primary power until measured

oxygen.method: Pipe oxygen into protected work zones or melt/process ice from connected cold terrain

radiation.method: Use native Wheezeworts and collect with a Radbolt Generator

zones.summary: Warm polluted-water Wetlands with Seakomb, Lura Plant, Gnit, Pacu, Jawbo, Gold Amalgam, and organic industrial inputs.

food.method: Ranch Pacu/Jawbo for seafood; protect supporting populations from uncontrolled predation

energy.method: Use Manual Generators unless the exact terrain union proves local Peat or another directly burnable fuel; polluted-water-to-hydrogen chains exceed the direct-path policy

oxygen.method: Use exposed Polluted Water offgassing as emergency Polluted Oxygen or clean that gas with one Deodorizer; water cleaning plus electrolysis exceeds the direct-path policy

radiation.method: Import Wheezeworts or Shine Bugs

attention: Do not assume Amber/Resin or Phyto Oil is immediate food or power without processing

zones.summary: Cold Spaced Out terrain with Uranium Ore, Beeta Hives, Wheezeworts, Saturn Critter Traps, Tranquil Toes, and radiation hazards.

food.method: Harvest native Saturn Critter Traps for Plant Meat only after providing a critter; treat the 30-cycle domestic growth and 4x wild slowdown as a specialty route, with Hydrogen as a separate by-product

energy.method: Use a Manual Generator for direct local startup; Beeta enrichment to Research Reactor to Steam Turbine is advanced multi-building background and is not ranked as direct

oxygen.method: Melt ice and electrolyze water, or pipe oxygen through protected access

radiation.method: Wheezeworts and Beeta Hives create ambient radiation; one Radbolt Generator is required to collect that field and produce radbolts. Reactor-based collection is advanced background needing shielding, cooling, access control, and automation

attention: Beetas are aggressive even around suited workers
Preserve Hives; they are strategically valuable and not normal replacements
Natural uranium tiles radiate but debris does not equivalently radiate

zones.summary: Aquatic Reef with Salt Water, Coquina, Corallium, Zinc Ore, Flue Coral, Starnacle, Clampum, Waterweed, Beakon, Blowter, Seaquine, Sanishell, Tropical Pacu, and Tidal Springs.

food.method: Ranch aquatic critters for seafood and use Seaquine Ovolene for Caviar after infrastructure is stable

energy.method: Install Tidal Turbines over attached native Tidal Springs for 300 W while active; output is cyclic rather than continuous, so retain backup generation

oxygen.method: Choose Flue Coral for direct farmed oxygen or Blowters for a combined oxygen-and-food ranch; measure current U59 inputs and output in game

radiation.method: Import Wheezeworts or Shine Bugs

attention: Flue Coral light requirement was increased in 735589
Salt Water, Lime/Phosphorite, Pearl and Wall Planter dependencies
Aquatic crowding is based on pool size
Do not use beta oxygen ratios without current in-game verification
Preserve natural backwalls until farm plans are final

zones.summary: Cool Rust terrain with Rust, Salt Water, Iron Ore, Nosh Sprouts, Dasha Saltvines, Dreckos, Squeaky Pufts, and sometimes Wheezeworts/Ethanol features.

food.method: Grow Nosh Sprouts only after securing variant-native or imported Ethanol and temperature control; ranch Dreckos for meat as a second path

energy.method: Use finite Ethanol pockets as a bridge; import lumber/ethanol or another sustainable fuel

oxygen.method: Run Rust Deoxidizers using native Rust plus Salt, then plan a replacement before finite stocks run out

radiation.method: Use native-variant Wheezeworts where generated; otherwise import them

attention: Rust and Salt oxygen is finite without renewal
Nosh Sprouts need Ethanol and cold conditions
Squeaky Puft and Drecko ranch gases
Do not count feature Ethanol lakes as renewable

zones.summary: Temperate starting terrain rich in Water, Dirt, Algae, Coal, Copper Ore, Mealwood, Bristle Blossom, Hatches, and Shine Bugs.

food.method: Use Muckroot briefly, then Mealwood or Bristle Blossom; ranch Hatches for barbecue and renewable Coal while feed lasts

energy.method: Burn native Coal and use Hatch ranching to extend supply; transition to hydrogen or another renewable source before feed minerals become limiting

oxygen.method: Use Algae Diffusers early, then electrolyze Water for sustained output

radiation.method: Ranch native Shine Bugs around a Radbolt Generator

attention: Algae, Coal, Dirt and Water are finite unless renewed
Bristle Blossom water and light demand
Heat accumulation from power and oxygen infrastructure

zones.summary: Most surface variants are vacuum-exposed terrain with regolith/mafic rock, meteors, solar access, Shove Voles, and ambient space radiation in Spaced Out; the installed Space zone union also contains border, Terra-surface, and module-interior definitions that are not all equivalent to open vacuum.

food.method: Ranch Shove Voles in escape-proof enclosures, or build sealed temperature-controlled farms behind backwalls

energy.method: Use Solar Panels with meteor protection and energy storage

oxygen.method: Use Atmo Suits and sealed backwalled rooms; pipe oxygen in and prevent space exposure from deleting it

radiation.method: Collect ambient space radiation directly with Radbolt Generators placed according to the planetoid's exposure level

attention: Atmo Suit oxygen and airlock failure

zones.summary: Very cold Nectar terrain with Bonbon Trees, Spigot Seals, Shine Bugs, Ice/Snow, Phosphorite, and low-melting Mercury.

food.method: Use Spigot Seal Tallow in supported food chains, but import a simpler staple crop for colony calories

energy.method: Feed Spigot Seals from Bonbon Trees and burn their direct Ethanol output in a Petroleum Generator; burn direct Bonbon Lumber in a Wood Burner as the separate one-building alternative

oxygen.method: Melt Ice/Snow and electrolyze Water, or import Alveo Vera from Ice Caves

radiation.method: Ranch native Shine Bugs

attention: Bonbon Trees require strong light for full production
Spigot Seal ranch scale and tree access
Mercury melts at very low temperature
Ethanol loop output is not free energy

zones.summary: Spaced Out Swampy terrain with Mud, Polluted Water/Oxygen, Bog Buckets, Swamp Chard, Pacu, Plug Slugs, and useful metal/mineral variants.

food.method: Use Swamp Chard forage briefly, then Bog Bucket farming and Pacu ranching

energy.method: Use wild Plug Slugs as early supplemental power at about 400 W when fully fed; 1,600 W is the domesticated full-fed rating, starvation lowers output further, and their metal feed is not free

oxygen.method: Use native Polluted Oxygen directly in an emergency or clean it with one Deodorizer; show Mud/Sludge-Press and cleaned-water electrolysis only as excluded advanced chains

radiation.method: Import Wheezeworts or Shine Bugs

attention: Plug Slug feed cost and nighttime behavior

zones.summary: Caustic/Jungle terrain with Hydrogen, Chlorine, Phosphorite, Pincha Pepperplants, Balm Lilies, Dreckos, and Morbs.

food.method: Ranch Dreckos for meat and use Pincha Peppernuts as a high-tier food ingredient; import a staple-calorie crop

energy.method: Capture finite native Hydrogen for a Hydrogen Generator, then transition to a renewable source

oxygen.method: Use Algae where the variant contains it or pipe oxygen through Atmo Suit access; do not open hydrogen/chlorine pockets into the base

radiation.method: Import Wheezeworts or Shine Bugs

zones.summary: Spaced Out Sulfur/Wasteland terrain with Grubfruit, Sweetles, and mineral-rich but water-poor variants.

food.method: Farm Grubfruit and ranch Sweetles; evolve ranching toward Grubgrubs only if the current feed/output chain is sustainable

energy.method: Import fuel or connect solar/geothermal power; native Sulfur supports biology but is not itself a direct generator fuel

oxygen.method: Use finite Oxylite pockets where generated, then import oxygen or water

radiation.method: Import Wheezeworts or Shine Bugs

attention: Do not mistake Sulfur abundance for direct electrical power
